g.text: Ablations: sensors and window length (classical models)

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #666666

g.text: * No feature uses the magnetometer, so removing it changes nothing. Random forest: mean of 5 seeds (error bar: seed sd); the others are deterministic. 2 s windows bring the unseen-mission false alarms of the random forest
